Design Principles

Core philosophy guiding every design decision

Clarity First
Every element serves a purpose. Remove anything that doesn't contribute to user understanding or action.
Generous Spacing
Whitespace is a design element. Give content room to breathe with ample padding and margins.
Subtle Interactions
Micro-interactions provide feedback without overwhelming. Smooth transitions, gentle hover states.
Typography Hierarchy
Clear visual hierarchy through size, weight, and color contrast. Readable line heights and letter spacing.
Consistent Rhythm
8px baseline grid creates visual harmony. All spacing multiples of 8px for mathematical precision.
